scene_description: A woman with long hair stands at a large airport window, holding a rolling suitcase and a handbag, looking out at an airplane flying in the sky.

questions.question: What is flying in the sky?
questions.evidence_hint: Look up in the top right corner of the picture.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the woman's body is doing and where she is facing.

questions.question: Where is the woman standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big glass wall behind the woman.

questions.question: What do people use a suitcase for?
sample_answers: to bring stuff on a trip
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the rolling bag next to the woman and think about trips.

questions.question: What might the woman do next?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at her suitcase and the airplane outside the window.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been on an airplane or to an airport?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you traveled somewhere.
